style: Editorial lifestyle photograph for Maison Maho, a travel-wear and lifestyle brand. Early autumn, warm late-afternoon natural light, soft shadows, muted palette of stone, sand, charcoal, navy and camel. Shot on 35mm film, shallow depth of field, natural skin, candid and unposed. Southern European setting. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no borders.

images.prompt: A woman in her thirties walks mid-stride along a sunlit narrow stone street in an old town, wearing a tailored charcoal grey sheath dress over a crisp white shirt and carrying a tan leather weekender bag. Full body, subject centered, room around her on both sides.
Close portrait of a woman with round tortoiseshell sunglasses and a linen shirt, leaning on a harbour wall with the sea softly out of focus behind her. Face centered in the frame.
A woman in a camel wool coat over a cream knit and wide sand trousers, standing in front of a plaster wall, three-quarter view, looking off frame. Centered, head to knees.
A man in a navy merino crew-neck sweater, white tee and stone chinos, hands in pockets, standing in front of a sunlit stone archway. Centered, head to knees.
Flat lay on natural linen: a tan leather crossbody bag, tortoiseshell sunglasses, a slim steel watch and a brass keyring, arranged with space between them. Overhead view, soft window light.

A bedroom corner with a bed in washed sand linen sheets, a folded charcoal throw at the foot, a ceramic vase with dried grass on a wooden side table and a stack of three books. Morning light through a sheer curtain.

Inside a small tailoring atelier: a long wooden table with rolls of linen and wool, a tailor's hands pinning the collar of a white shirt on a dress form, scissors and chalk beside them. Warm window light, dust in the air.
Three friends in autumn knits and trench coats laughing on a rooftop terrace at golden hour, terracotta roofs and a bell tower out of focus behind them. Group centered, wide frame.
Close-up texture study of a folded chunky cream wool scarf and a navy cable-knit sweater on a wooden bench, soft side light. Fills the frame.
Full-length view of a woman in a sand trench coat and white sneakers walking down a wide stone staircase, seen from below, tall vertical composition with the subject centered.
Brown leather lace-up boots and the hem of charcoal wool trousers standing on wet cobblestones, low angle, morning light. Feet centered.
A tan leather weekender bag on the seat of a vintage train carriage, a folded linen shirt and a paperback beside it, countryside passing softly outside the window. Wide frame, bag centered.

Overhead view of an open canvas suitcase on a wooden floor, neatly packed with folded linen shirts, a navy sweater, sunglasses, a leather notebook and a pair of loafers. Wide horizontal composition, suitcase centered, items in the middle band of the frame.

Three gift boxes wrapped in kraft paper with charcoal grosgrain ribbon and a sprig of dried eucalyptus, on a linen tablecloth beside a ceramic cup of coffee. Wide horizontal composition, boxes centered in the middle band of the frame.
